Super Hat Bros

SUPERHAT BROS

A platform fighter. Rack up damage, launch them off the stage, and remember: everyone looks better in a hat.

Two players, one keyboard
Player 1 sits on the left and only uses the left half. Player 2 sits on the right and only uses the right half. Nobody crosses the middle.
Player 1 (left half)
Left hand: Move A D · Up W · Crouch / fast fall S · Jump Space
Right hand: Attack F · Special G · Shield H · Smash T (or R)
Player 2 (right half)
Right hand: Move ← → · Up ↑ · Crouch ↓ · Jump Right Shift (or Enter)
Left hand: Attack , · Special . · Shield / · Smash M
Got a numpad? Numpad 1 attack, 2 special, 3 shield, 0 jump, 4 smash.
Smash-style moves
Hold a direction + Smash key = Smash attack (keep holding to charge). Flick a direction + Attack also works.
Hold a direction + Attack = tilt. Attack while running = dash attack.
Attack in the air + direction = aerials. Down-air is a meteor. Up is only for up-attacks unless you turn on "Also W / ↑" for jumping.
Online, two devices
Phones, laptops, desktops, any mix. Tap ONLINE (2 DEVICES). One device taps HOST and gets a 4-letter code. The other taps JOIN and types it. The host is Player 1, picks the stage and starts the fight; both players pick their own fighter. On a computer either set of keys controls your fighter.
Best on the same Wi-Fi. Keep phones awake: switching apps drops the game. If it won't connect across two different networks, that's a carrier firewall, not you.
Ronnie-Mode!
Tap ← ↑ → ↓ quickly in a row (keys or joystick). Time slows, your fighter ties on a karate headband and shows off some moves, and the music switches to the Ronnie-Mode theme.
For 20 seconds: Attack = long-reach karate chops (Karate Chop, Rising Chop, Low Chop, Mega Chop) and Special = Flying Kick, Spinning Jump Kick, Dive Kick and Sweep Kick. Then a 15-second cooldown before you can do it again.
Sound & music
The music is Ronnie's own tunes played on piano: track 1 on the menus, track 2 during fights. Use the Music and Sound buttons in the top-right to turn either off.
No sound on a phone? iPhone: flip the ring/silent switch to ring, or turn up the volume after the game starts playing music. Android: the game uses the media volume, not the ringer, so press volume-up while the game is open.
On a phone
Drag anywhere on the left half to use the joystick. Right side: A attack, B special, JUMP, SHIELD.
Flick the stick + A at the same time = smash attack. Stick up + A is an up attack. Only the JUMP button jumps.
Start your thumb a little in from the phone's edge so the phone's back-swipe doesn't grab it. Add to Home Screen for the best feel.
Napkin fighters
Spike (goat): Side+B Goat Ram, B Horn Toss, Down+B Hoof Stomp (air dive) or Stomp Quake (ground).
Noodles (orca): Side+B Breach leap, B water Spout, Down+B Belly Flop or Splash.
Pency (pencil): B fires 3 shavings, Side+B slow Bag Swing that kills, Down+B Pencil Drop spike.
Bootisaurus (2x size): B Chomp, Side+B Lace Whip tail sweep, Down+B Boot Stomp. Very hard to launch, very easy to hit.
Baggy (no arms): four jumps and floats, B pulls random junk from the bag, Side+B Bag Roll, Down+B Puff Up.
Snakey (snake cop): B tosses two tickets, Side+B Slither Charge, Down+B Coil Counter: get hit during it and he hits back instead.
Cloudy (cloud, no legs): five jumps, hold JUMP in the air to hover. B Lightning Bolt, Side+B Gust pushes far, Down+B Thunderhead Drop or Rain Dance.
Franchesca (fish with legs): rolls go farther and faster. B Bubble Shot floats up, Side+B Fish Flop hops forward, Down+B Belly Flop or Splash Zone.
Shoean (shoe): fastest runner. B Lace Shot, Side+B Lace Lasso pulls them in, Down+B Heel Drop or Scuff. Run longer before a dash attack for a SPRINT! bonus.
Luke Lava (lava blob): every hit sets you on fire for 2 seconds. Lava can't hurt him. B Fireball, Side+B Lava Flow multi-hit slide, Down+B Meteor Drop or Magma Pool, which leaves a burning puddle under him.
Kayden (ninja knife): hits from behind do 30% more, rolls are shadow steps. B three Shuriken, Side+B Blade Dash, Down+B Smoke Bomb turns him near-invisible.
Po-po (bead cop): bounces when he lands hard. B Donut Toss, Side+B Cuff Toss pulls them in, Down+B Siren Spin.
Larry (giraffe): the longest reach in the game, especially upward. B Neck Snap, Side+B Gallop, Down+B Hoof Drop or Leaf Shower.
Raggy (jailbird sack): Side+B Sack Swing is a huge wide whip, Down+B Bag Over Head pulls them in. B Rock Toss.
Ian (elephant): heaviest fighter, armor on smashes. B Trumpet shoves everything away, Side+B Trunk Grab pulls them in, Down+B Belly Drop or Big Stomp.
Gary (sheep mayor): wool softens every hit he takes by 15%. B Campaign Flyers, Side+B Wool Roll, Down+B Gavel Drop or Town Meeting.
Jacc (jackrabbit): fastest hopper, three jumps, giant hind feet. B Carrot Toss, Side+B Big Hop, Down+B Stomp Drop or Thump.
Horseshoe Crab (crab in sneakers): wide, low and hard to launch, armor on smashes. B Bubble Blast, Side+B Claw Grab pulls them in, Down+B Sneaker Slam or Shoe Stomp.
Gigi (monkey in a straitjacket): no hands, so it's all feet, tail and head. Wiggles out of trouble with long rolls. B Banana Peel, Side+B Tail Whip, Down+B Butt Drop or Tantrum.
Foxy (sly fox, the other big bad guy): bites chew shields, backstabs do 30% more. B Fox Fire, Side+B Pounce, Down+B Sly Trick: a counter that punishes anyone who swings first.
Signature mechanics
Spike: smashes have armor, weak hits won't stop them. Noodles: bites chew shields twice as fast. Pency: land the tip of a stab for a TIP! bonus. Bootisaurus: heavy armor on smashes and Lace Whip. Baggy: Pogo Stomp bounces off whoever it hits. Snakey: Baton Combo chains three hits, Tail Trip pulls the opponent in. Cloudy: hover by holding JUMP, zap moves crackle with lightning. Franchesca: slippery rolls. Shoean: Sprint Kick scales with run-up. Luke Lava: burning hits, immune to lava. Kayden: backstabs. Po-po: bounces. Larry: reach. Raggy: pulls. Ian: armor and weight. Gary: wool armor. Jacc: triple jump. Horseshoe Crab: shell armor and grabs. Gigi: wiggle rolls. Foxy: shield-chewing bites, backstabs, counter.
Final Smashes
Every 60 seconds a random fighter glows. Press Special with no direction to unleash it. Lose a stock and you lose it.
Spike Mega Ram · Noodles Tidal Wave · Pency Bank Heist · Bootisaurus Boot Quake · Baggy Trash Tornado · Snakey Full Arrest · Cloudy Super Storm · Franchesca School of Fish · Shoean Marathon Dash · Luke Lava Eruption · Kayden Thousand Blades · Po-po Riot Charge · Larry Tall Order · Raggy Jailbreak · Ian Stampede · Gary Mayor's Parade · Jacc Rabbit Stampede · Horseshoe Crab Sneaker Storm · Gigi Breakout · Foxy Night Hunt.
Stages
Twenty-one arenas: Hat Haven, the classic battlefield with three floating platforms, plus one home stage per fighter. Desert Hop has a rolling tumbleweed, Tide Pool a drifting raft, Jungle Gym a bobbing set of monkey bars, and Foxy's Den has something watching from the burrow. Raggy's is The Slammer, a jail, because he got caught. Lava Lift is Luke Lava's and a hazard stage: lava rains from the volcano, burns on contact and leaves burning puddles. Luke is immune. Fish Tank is underwater with slow falls and swaying seaweed, Shoebox Stack is a shoe store with a sliding box, Cloud Nine floats in the sky with drifting cloud platforms, Goat Peak has high side ledges, Orca Cove has a drifting boat, Pency's Vault has a platform that rides up and down, Boot Canyon is one giant boot, Baggy's Dump has rolling tires, Snakey's Precinct has patrolling squad cars. Pick Random to shuffle.
Defense & specials
Shield + Left/Right = roll · Shield + Down = spot dodge · Shield in the air = air dodge.
Up + Special = recovery. Special alone = projectile. Side + Special = lunge.
Fall near the edge to grab the ledge. Esc pauses.

Three stocks. Higher damage % = farther launch. Last fighter standing wins. Every minute one random fighter gets a Final Smash: press Special to unleash it. The hat button in the bottom-left puts a hat on everyone, bells and all.

Super Hat Bros is a free Smash-style platform fighting game you can play in your browser on a phone or computer, no download needed. Twenty fighters drawn on napkins by a kid named Ronnie: Spike the goat, Noodles the orca, Pency the bank-robbing pencil, Bootisaurus Rex, Baggy, Snakey, Cloudy, Franchesca, Shoean, Luke Lava, Kayden, Po-po, Larry the giraffe, Raggy, Ian the elephant, Mayor Gary, Jacc the jackrabbit, Horseshoe Crab, Gigi the monkey and Foxy the fox. Play solo against the CPU, two players on one keyboard, or online on two phones with a room code. Music by Ronnie.

Play online, two devices

Phones, laptops or desktops, any mix. One device hosts and gets a 4-letter code. The other types that code to join. On a computer, both players use the Player 1 keys (WASD, Space, F G H, T) or the Player 2 keys, either works. Best when both devices are on the same Wi-Fi.
